Self-hosted reading tools and library forensics by **felixapel**.
### 🛡️ Calibre Bookwarden Content-grounded metadata verification and cover forensics guardian for Calibre libraries. The book file is the ground truth, LLMs are witnesses. Includes read-only 360° forensic audits, swipeable Cover Deck triage UI, Series Gap Hunter, multi-format duplicate consolidation, and sealed cryptographic proofs. * **Template:** `calibre-bookwarden.xml` * **WebUI:** http://[IP]:8080/ * **Repository:** [GitHub](https://github.com/felixapel/calibre-bookwarden)
### 🌐 CWA eBook Translate Bilingual reading for [Calibre-Web-Automated](https://github.com/crocodilestick/Calibre-Web-Automated). Translate ebooks paragraph-by-paragraph *while you read*, in 100+ languages, using local LLMs (Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio) or major cloud APIs. * **Repository:** [GitHub](https://github.com/felixapel/CWA-eBook-Translate-Plugin)
**Support:** * Bugs: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/felixapel/calibre-bookwarden/issues) * Discussions: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/felixapel/calibre-bookwarden/discussions) * Contact: felixguillermoapel@gmail.com
